not_modelled.what: Dependent allowance on Line 10d, from Schedule IL-E/EITC; the amount is not printed in the documents read.
Exemption of 1,000 for each legally blind filer or spouse (Line 10c); a projection does not know this.
The reduced Line 10a amounts when someone can claim the filer or spouse as a dependent (Line C).
Interest on U.S. Treasury and agency obligations, and the matching share of mutual fund distributions, is subtracted on Schedule M Line 22; a projection cannot tell it from other interest.
Interest realized on the redemption of U.S. retirement bonds is subtracted on Line 5; a projection cannot tell it from other interest.
Capital gains on employer securities from a lump-sum distribution are subtracted to the extent of net unrealized appreciation; a projection cannot tell them from other gains.
Group term life premiums paid by a retirement plan and included as wages are subtracted on Line 5; a projection cannot tell them from other wages.
Military pay earned is subtracted on Schedule M Line 21; a projection cannot tell it from other wages.
Retirement payments to retired partners; Pub 120 and the IL-1040 instructions send them to Schedule M, Schedule M Line 14 sends them to Line 5, and no income kind matches.

approximations.what: A pension or plan withdrawal from a plan that is not a qualified employee benefit plan and not a government plan is treated as subtractable, and so is ordinary income for which the 10-year averaging method was elected. Pub 120 refuses both; the projection cannot tell.
Annuity income is left out of the Line 5 subtraction (covers_unclear in the record). An annuity paid from a qualified employee benefit plan qualifies.

All municipal bond interest is taxed. Illinois adds back all federally tax-exempt interest and exempts only listed obligations (Schedule M Lines 34 and 35), which a projection cannot tell from others.
approximations.size: 4.95% of the interest on listed bonds held directly.

approximations.what: Interest on U.S. Treasury and agency obligations and on U.S. retirement bonds is taxed (the projection cannot tell it from other interest).
Employer-securities gains and group term life premiums that Line 5 subtracts, and military pay subtracted on Schedule M, are taxed.
The dependent allowance (Line 10d) and the blind exemption (Line 10c) are not applied.
approximations.size: 49.50 a year for a blind person.

approximations.what: A filer who can be claimed as a dependent gets the full Line 10a amount; the chart reduces it.

Credits are not applied: tax paid to another state (Line 15), property tax and K-12 education (Line 16), and Schedule 1299-C (Line 17). Other Schedule M subtractions, such as college savings contributions, are not applied either.
